results.content: # A lung CT vision foundation model facilitating disease diagnosis and medical imaging. LCTfound is a large-scale lung CT foundation model trained on 105,184 scans that jointly encodes imaging and clinical data to support eight clinical tasks, outperforming strong baselines across centers. It provides a unified, deployable framework for diagnosis, prognosis, reconstruction, and navigation, potentially standardizing AI-assisted thoracic imaging. If prospectively validated and integrated, this model could improve consistency and speed of thoracic imaging interpretation, enhance lesion detection/segmentation, support treatment planning, and enable advanced reconstruction in low-dose or sparse-view settings. A scalable, multicenter-validated foundation model for lung CT is likely to reshape AI-enabled imaging workflows and catalyze research across diagnosis, prognosis, and therapy planning. * Lack of prospective, randomized clinical deployment studies demonstrating impact on patient outcomes. Prospective clinical trials, regulatory-grade validation, fairness auditing across demographics and scanners, and integration studies assessing workflow efficiency, safety, and outcome benefits. :   IV - Model development and retrospective multicenter evaluations without prospective clinical randomization.
